# claimResponse.mjs misses participle-lead and #N contributor claims

## Context

On 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21, seven outside-contributor claim comments on curated (`good first issue` / `help wanted`) issues were skipped by `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` with `No reply: not a claim, the assignee, or a claimant already answered here`:

1. [`#19920#issuecomment-6296369622`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19920#issuecomment-6296369622) (`@bercedev`, `2026-10-20T16:56:33Z`): `"I'll take the \`examples/layout/form\` row: the leftover \`child\` in \`src/layout/Form.mjs\`'s \`applyChildAttributes\`, with a unit test."`
2. [`#19920#issuecomment-6296509810`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19920#issuecomment-6296509810) (`@bercedev`, `2026-10-20T17:03:37Z`): `"I'll also take the \`examples/component/wrapper/openStreetMaps\` row, as a separate PR: ..."`
3. [`#19920#issuecomment-6296901777`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19920#issuecomment-6296901777) (`@kaushlendra-pt-singh`, `2026-10-20T17:23:54Z`): `"Dude i am taking the examples/calendar/weekview row for now."`
4. [`#19930#issuecomment-6310572490`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19930#issuecomment-6310572490) (`@kaushlendra-pt-singh`, `2026-10-21T07:30:22Z`, run [`39562455909`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/39562455909)): `"Claiming #19930. Working on the calendar/weekview fix."`
5. [`#19931#issuecomment-6310933510`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19931#issuecomment-6310933510) (`@Uddoo`, `2026-10-21T07:52:16Z`, run [`39565052832`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/39565052832)): `"I'm starting work on #19931: reproduce the selector-container failure, keep day-view initialization safe while its bound formatter is unavailable, and verify the regression in the unit tier and the rendered example."`
6. [`#19933#issuecomment-6312930496`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19933#issuecomment-6312930496) (`@bercedev`, `2026-10-21T09:43:35Z`, run [`39579184611`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/39579184611)): `"Claiming #19933. Working on the popover fix in \`afterSetIsVnodeInitializing\`."`
7. [`#19952#issuecomment-6316099350`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19952#issuecomment-6316099350) (`@Jah-yee`, `2026-10-21T12:38:31Z`, run [`39601227881`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/39601227881)): `"Claiming this one, so nobody duplicates the work."`

## The Problem

`isClaim(body)` in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` drives both:
1. `decideReply()` (`:293`) — whether the new claimant receives the welcome / already-taken reply; and
2. `earlierClaim()` (`:169`) — whether an unassigned earlier contributor claim holds the issue (`asked first`) against later claimants for `CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS`.

Because `CLAIM_PATTERNS` (`:49-58`) currently requires:
- a leading pronoun on action verbs (`/\b(i'?ll|i will|let me)\s+(take|work\s+on|pick\s+up|handle|tackle|claim)\s+(this|it)\b/i` without `(also\s+)?` and without `the ... row` or `#\d+` targets), and
- only `i'm` + `working on` + `(this|it)` on progressive verbs (`/\bi'?m\s+(already\s+)?working\s+on\s+(this|it)\b/i`),

it returns `false` on:
- clause-leading participle claims (`"Claiming #19930..."`, `"Claiming this one..."`, `"Taking #19933..."`, `"Picking up this issue..."`);
- progressive first-person claims (`"I am taking the ... row"`, `"I'm starting work on #19931..."`, `"I'm claiming this"`, `"I'm picking up #19930"`);
- future/modal claims that include `also` or target `#\d+` / `the ... row` (`"I'll take the \`examples/layout/form\` row"`, `"I'll also take the \`examples/component/wrapper/openStreetMaps\` row"`, `"I'll take #19930"`).

When `isClaim()` misses a real claim, the contributor gets no confirmation reply and a subsequent claimant within the 7-day window is falsely told `"You're first in line"`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs:49-58` defines `CLAIM_PATTERNS` and `isClaim(body)` (`:80-84`).
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs:39-72` tests `isClaim` against positive fixtures and negative controls, specifically `assigneeThanks` (`:42`, `"Thanks! I appreciate the assignment and the detailed setup instructions. I'll follow the steps, write the regression test, and work on the fix. I'll ask here if I run into any issues."`) and questions/refusals/notes.
- Design authority: `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs:75-76` (`"Whether a comment asks to work on the issue. A question, thanks or a note about something else is not a claim, and gets no reply: answering every comment would amplify exactly the noise a quiet issue should not carry."`) and `#19202`.

## The Fix

Define a shared `CLAIM_TARGET = String.raw\`(this|it|#\d+|the\s[^\n]{1,80}?\brow\b)\`` in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` and update `CLAIM_PATTERNS` so that:
1. Future/imperative first-person claims (`\b(i'?ll|i will|let me)\s+(also\s+)?(take|work\s+on|pick\s+up|handle|tackle|claim)\s+${CLAIM_TARGET}`) match optional `also` and `CLAIM_TARGET` (`this`, `it`, `#\d+`, or `the ... row`), without matching `assigneeThanks` or ordinary notes (`"I'll take the feedback into account."`).
2. Progressive first-person claims (`\b(i'?m|i am)\s+(already\s+|also\s+)?(working\s+on|starting\s+work\s+on|taking|claiming|picking\s+up|tackling|handling)\s+${CLAIM_TARGET}`) match both `I'm` and `I am`, progressive claim verbs (`working on`, `starting work on`, `taking`, `claiming`, `picking up`, `tackling`, `handling`), and `CLAIM_TARGET`, without matching repro reports (`"I'm starting the dev server..."`).
3. Clause-initial participle claims (`(?:^|[.!?\n]\s*)(claiming|taking|picking\s+up)\s+${CLAIM_TARGET}`) match sentence/line-leading `"Claiming #19930"`, `"Claiming this one"`, `"Taking #19933"`, `"Picking up this issue"`, without matching mid-sentence questions (`"Is anyone claiming this?"`) or notes (`"Taking the example from the docs..."`).
4. Add all seven real 2026-10-20 / 2026-10-21 contributor claim comments and negative controls (mid-sentence questions, repro reports, thank-you notes, and status notes) to `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs`.

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `isClaim(body)` / `CLAIM_PATTERNS` in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` | `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs:75-76`, `#19202` | Recognizes clause-initial participle claims (`Claiming`/`Taking`/`Picking up`), progressive `I'm`/`I am` claims (`working on`/`starting work on`/`taking`/`claiming`/`picking up`/`tackling`/`handling`), and `I'll (also)` claims targeting `CLAIM_TARGET` (`(this\|it\|#\d+\|the\s[^\n]{1,80}?\brow\b)`), while keeping `assigneeThanks`, questions, refusals, repro reports, notes, and quoted/fenced text `false` | `false` (no reply) | `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` JSDoc | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` [L2] |

## Decision Record impact

`none` — bug fix in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` preserving the `#19202` / `#19413` pure-function responder contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `isClaim()` returns `true` for all seven real outside-contributor claims from `#19920`, `#19930`, `#19931`, `#19933`, and `#19952`, and `earlierClaim()` / `decideReply()` treat them as valid claims and holds.
- [ ] AC-2: `isClaim()` continues to return `false` for `assigneeThanks`, questions (`"Is this still available?"`, `"Is anyone claiming this?"`, `"Are you taking #19930?"`), refusals, repro reports/notes (`"I'm starting the dev server..."`, `"I'll take the feedback into account."`), and fenced code blocks.
- [ ] AC-3: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` passes with new regression arms covering the seven real comments and negative controls.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` permissions or trigger conditions.
- Auto-assigning issues without maintainer confirmation.

## Avoided Traps

- Matching bare `working on`, `claiming`, `starting`, or `the\b` without a scoped work-item target (`CLAIM_TARGET`), which would false-positive on questions (`"Is anyone claiming this?"`), repro reports (`"I'm starting the dev server..."`), or thank-you notes (`"I'll take the feedback into account."`).
